name: ARN Smart Content Toolkit
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
🧠 ARN Smart Content Toolkit is a workflow-first content operations plugin for WordPress.

Instead of simple one-click duplication, the plugin focuses on controlled draft preparation, structured content workflows, title transformation, smart replace operations, and builder-aware content handling.

Users can prepare editable drafts, duplicate content with dynamic title changes, run find-and-replace workflows on selected content, preview actions before execution, and create review-based similar drafts from public URLs.

✅ The plugin is designed for safer editorial workflows — not uncontrolled publishing automation.

Core Workflow Features

🚀 Smart Draft Preparation

Prepare editable drafts before publishing instead of blindly duplicating live content. Copies are created as drafts by default.

✏️ Prepare With New Title

Duplicate content while automatically preparing a completely new title and slug structure.

Useful for:

  • 📄 landing page variations
  • 🛠️ service page workflows
  • 📍 location-based drafts
  • 🗂️ structured editorial preparation

🧪 Content Variation Preparation

Prepare several editable draft copies of existing WordPress content in one run (up to 10 items in the free version).

🔄 Smart Find & Replace Workflow

Replace words, phrases, locations, product names, or structured text in the title and content of the content you select.

The mini preview shows the affected content before the action runs.

🌐 Similar Draft Workflow

Analyze a public URL, preview detected structure and images, then prepare a review-based editable draft. The free version allows 3 similar drafts per day.

⚠️ The workflow is intentionally manual and review-first.

  • No automatic publishing.
  • No autonomous crawling.
  • No background mass scraping.

⚙️ Builder-Aware Content Handling

Designed for modern WordPress editors and structured content workflows.

The plugin detects structured builder content and keeps workflows draft-based for safer manual review before publishing.

🗑️ Plugin Data on Delete

An optional “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” setting is available at the bottom of the ARN Clonex screen for administrators. It is off by default.

Main Features

  • 🖥️ Single workflow screen
  • 🧠 Smart workflow modes
  • 🚀 Smart draft preparation
  • ✏️ Prepare with new title
  • 🔄 Title transformation workflows
  • 🔁 Find & replace on selected content
  • 🧪 Content variation preparation
  • 🔗 Reference-based editable drafts
  • 🌐 Similar draft workflow
  • 🧩 Builder-aware handling
  • 📦 Controlled batch draft preparation
  • 🛡️ Draft-first workflow
  • 🏷️ Taxonomy move workflow
  • 👁️ Mini preview system
  • 📜 Action history
  • ⚠️ Slug conflict prevention
  • 🖼️ Media-aware handling
  • 🏷️ Taxonomy-aware handling
  • ✍️ Editable draft preparation
  • 🔍 Manual review workflow
  • 🗑️ Optional data removal when the plugin is deleted
  • 🤖 Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key, model, usage and monthly limits); the Toolkit itself sends no AI requests

💎 Pro Version

ARN Smart Clonex is the Pro version from ARN Smart. It expands the workflow with larger-scale content operations and is available on arnsmart.com.

Pro adds, among others:

  • ⚙️ Bulk jobs with pause, resume, and cancel controls
  • 🌍 Bulk URL import workflows
  • 🗂️ Content templates and datasets
  • 🧪 Variation and production workflows
  • 👁️ Operation history and a debug console

The free version focuses on controlled draft preparation and lightweight workflow tools. It works on its own and does not require the Pro version or a license.

External services

The Toolkit connects to external websites only in the Similar Draft workflow, and only when a user asks for it. The bundled Settings > ARN Free AI screen contacts an AI provider only when an administrator uses it (see “ARN Free AI” below).

Similar Draft.

  • What is contacted: the public web page whose URL the user enters, and the image addresses found on that page that the user selects (these can be on other hosts, such as an image CDN).
  • When: when the user clicks to analyze the URL and again when the user saves the draft; selected images are downloaded when the draft is saved.
  • What is sent: a standard HTTP request for that address. The request includes a User-Agent header with the plugin name and this site’s address. No content, user data, or analytics are sent to ARN Smart or to any other service.
  • What is received: the page HTML (up to 2 MB) used to build the editable draft, and the selected images (at most 30, only images listed on that page, only real image files), which are added to the Media Library. Images are downloaded only for users who can upload files; for other users the draft keeps the original image addresses.
  • Limits: each user can analyze at most 10 URLs per hour.

The contacted website is chosen by the user, and that website’s own terms of use and privacy policy apply. Only copy content you have the right to use.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. ARN Smart Content Toolkit itself sends no content to any AI provider and does not contact any ARN server. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

Other ARN Smart Products

  • ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor — Free Elementor components and site utilities.
  • ARN Smart Vendix — Pro Elementor components plus SEO, Schema, AEO/GEO/AIO analysis, and sitemap foundations.
  • ARN Smart Clonex — Advanced content duplication, templates, bulk production, and relationship-aware workflows.
  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer — Lightweight image optimization and WebP handling.
  • ARN Smart WebPix — Pro WebP/AVIF conversion, delivery controls, and media optimization.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager — Short links, redirects, QR codes, URL health, and analytics.
  • ARN Smart Linkix — Pro link management, bio pages, advanced QR tools, and reporting.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent — Visitor-intent capture, smart triggers, analytics, and contact actions.
  • ARN Smart Visioix — Visitor and website intelligence for change, intent, and performance.
sections.installation:
1. 📂 Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. ⚡ Activate ARN Smart Content Toolkit.
  3. 🧩 Open ARN Clonex from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. 🛠️ Use the workflow screen for draft preparation, title changes, replace operations, taxonomy workflows, and preview tools.
  5. 🌐 Use the Similar Draft screen (ARN Clonex → Similar Draft) when preparing editable drafts from public reference URLs.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically publish generated drafts?

No. Copies are created as drafts by default, and Similar Draft always creates a draft. The workflow screen also offers Pending and Publish statuses; content is published only when you choose that status yourself and your account is allowed to publish that content type.

Does the plugin replace my live content automatically?

No. Nothing runs in the background. The Replace Text and Move Category / Taxonomy actions change the selected existing content only when you run them, after the mini preview.

Does the plugin support structured content workflows?

Yes. The plugin supports workflow-based draft preparation, structured duplication, replace workflows, and builder-aware handling.

Does the plugin create content from external websites automatically?

No. External URL handling is limited, manual, and review-based. The plugin does not perform autonomous publishing or uncontrolled background operations. See “External services” below.

Does the plugin support builder-aware workflows?

Yes. The plugin includes builder-aware handling for structured WordPress content workflows and compatible editor environments.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

By default, only a few old setting names are removed and your Toolkit data is kept. If an administrator enables “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” on the ARN Clonex screen, deleting the plugin also removes the Toolkit’s settings, action history, process log, temporary Similar Draft data, and the tracking fields the Toolkit added to posts and images. On Multisite this is applied on each site according to that site’s own setting. With the setting on, the shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of the sites where it is on are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.

Posts, pages, and images created with the plugin are never deleted. Data of the Pro version (ARN Smart Clonex) is not touched.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, usage and monthly limits). ARN Smart Content Toolkit itself sends no AI requests.
  • New: optional “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” setting on the ARN Clonex screen (off by default). Posts, pages, and images created with the plugin are never deleted. When it is enabled, deleting the plugin also removes the shared ARN Free AI settings and usage history, but only if no other installed plugin still uses them.
  • Security: copying now checks that the user can create the content type, and can publish it when the copy is published, scheduled, or private.
  • Security: Similar Draft now checks that the user can create the selected content type before the URL is fetched.
  • Security: Similar Draft adds images to the Media Library only for users who can upload files, only images found on the analyzed page (at most 30), and only real image files.
  • Security: URL analyses are limited to 10 per user per hour.
  • Security: the action history shows only entries about content you can edit.
  • Fixed: Simple Mode no longer reports a prepared draft or an update when no content was chosen; it asks you to choose content first.
  • Checked on PHP 8.5: no changes were needed for PHP 8.5.
  • Improved: the plugin loads only in the WordPress admin.
  • Improved: the workflow preview builds its elements with safe DOM methods instead of HTML strings.
  • Removed an unused request that could overwrite a site option.
  • Removed: unused internal code, including an uncalled URL import method and reads of settings that had no screen. Copy titles and slugs are unchanged.

1.0.3

  • Restored the Copy row action for supported posts and pages.
  • Kept basic full-draft copying available independently from the Pro license state.
  • Prevented duplicate Copy links when Free and Pro are enabled together.
  • Preserved exact Elementor data, empty draft slugs, nonce checks, and edit permissions.

1.0.2

Moved Prepare with Toolkit into the Copy popup, added direct exact-draft creation, preserved Elementor JSON and settings, regenerated Elementor CSS safely, and fixed title-based draft permalinks.

1.0.1

  • Fixed the Prepare with Toolkit row action to create a full draft copy and open the prepared draft directly.
  • Improved post list workflow access for editor-level users.
  • Updated release metadata for the maintenance release.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Workflow-first content operations interface.
  • Smart draft preparation workflows.
  • Prepare with new title workflow.
  • Find & replace while duplicating.
  • Similar draft workflow.
  • Builder-aware content handling.
  • Controlled batch draft preparation.
  • Draft-first workflow system.
  • Taxonomy move workflow.
  • Mini preview and action history.
  • Slug conflict prevention improvements.
  • WordPress 7.0 compatibility improvements.
  • Release stability and workflow refinements.
